scope: Mobile vlog layout, always-visible comments and locally baked edge-aware smoothing
causes: No-comment threads returned null, hiding the composer until the comment button was pressed
LoopVideo and home preview used object-cover, cropping arbitrary source aspect ratios
Camera controls shared a non-shrinking full-height column with the preview and filter panel
Capture height did not follow VisualViewport keyboard resize
File export relied on requestAnimationFrame and produced too few frames in the embedded browser
fixes: Render empty-state, comments and composer for every saved log; comment button is now a focus shortcut
Preserve drafts and report submission errors; synchronously prevent duplicate sends
Contain source video instead of cropping; wrap long names and use single-column films below 360px
Keep shutter/post controls outside the scrolling editor and follow VisualViewport height and offset
Move caption input out of the video overlay into its own field below the preview
Separate off/natural/smooth beauty controls and 0-100 strength from optional artistic colors
Apply edge-aware, color-independent whole-frame smoothing in the shared live/file WebGL renderer
Use bounded 24fps file processing with abort, visibility and insufficient-frame guards

browserQA.environment: Codex in-app browser; synthetic source and local upload/save adapters, no real couple mutations
browserQA.keyboardSizedViewport: 320x320 preview input at y157..205, post button at y252..300; viewport resize simulation, not a native keyboard
browserQA.comments: Initially empty composer visible without click, successful comment visible, failed comment draft retained
browserQA.gpuBeauty: Checker noise contrast reduced 24 to 16 at strength 70%; hard edge contrast retained 133 vs original 137
browserQA.liveBeauty: 35% and 70% processed canvas recordings, 75-76 frames; decoded 320x240, approximately 3.09s
browserQA.fileBeauty: Original color plus 70% smoothing reencoded to video/mp4;codecs=avc1, 13266 bytes, decoded duration 3.117433s, 320x240
browserQA.temporaryRoutes: QA route moved outside src/app before shipping

automatedChecks.productionBuild: passed, /our-days base path; no QA routes

limitations: Whole-frame smoothing, not AI face recognition, selective blemish removal, eye enlargement or facial reshaping
Physical iOS Safari/Android camera, native keyboard and low-end device performance not directly verified
No real storage/database writes were performed in isolated UI QA
